name: Black Ruby
description: This paint is blacker than a soul of your potential enemy. Our best specialists scrupulously attach each Ruby plate to gravity ties among dark matter particles.
interestingFacts: This paint appeared in game on November 29th, 2024.
This paint was only obtainable through the Advent Calendar offer sold during Black Friday 2024, which unlocked access to a unique advent calendar with many rewards. Price of the offer was 8 000.
